facetRefAmendment.rationale: Each authentication requirement defines an observable trigger, precondition, action, state transition, output or side effect. The upstream Behaviour facet is the primary observation perspective for those transitions. The current Phase 2 structured metadata omits this facet reference even though the Phase 3 coverage analysis identifies the behaviours.
facetRefAmendment.evidence: Software Rules facets/README.md and facets/FACET-BOUNDARIES.md at the pinned commit; Behaviour is defined by triggers, preconditions, transitions, outputs and side effects.
facetRefAmendment.compatibilityNote: This is a metadata-only proposal. It does not change requirement text, normative meaning, platform scope or owner-approval status. Add the facetRef to each listed requirement in both the canonical Markdown Facets lists and structured extension metadata in the same versioned update, then refresh the declared-contract artifact revision, digest and retained evidence.
